record.paper_title: Lower Bounds for Unrestricted Boolean Circuits: Open Problems
record.original_question: Can one prove superlinear lower bounds for linear Boolean circuits that use only parity gates, especially for multi-output linear maps of the form f(x) = Ax over {0,1}?

evidence.quote: Can we at least prove superlinear lower bounds for circuits consisting of parity gates only? This question makes sense for multi-output functions. Specifically, let us focus on functions of the form f(x) = Ax where A ∈ {0, 1}n×n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A linear Boolean circuit (over $\mathbb{F}_2$) is a directed acyclic graph in which every non-input gate has fan-in 2 and computes the XOR (parity) of its two inputs; the input nodes are labeled by variables $x_1,\dots,x_n$, and a designated set of $n$ output gates produces the output. The size of such a circuit is its number of gates. For a matrix $A \in \{0,1\}^{n\times n}$, the linear map $f_A: \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}^n$ defined by $f_A(x) = Ax$ (with arithmetic over $\mathbb{F}_2$) can be computed by some linear Boolean circuit; let $L(A)$ denote the minimum size of any such circuit computing $f_A$.

It is known that for a uniformly random $A \in \{0,1\}^{n\times n}$ one has $L(A) = \Theta(n^2/\log n)$ with high probability, while for every explicit family of matrices $\{A_n\}$ the best known unconditional lower bound on $L(A_n)$ is only $3n - o(n)$.

Problem: Exhibit an explicit family of matrices $\{A_n\}_{n\ge1}$ with $A_n \in \{0,1\}^{n\times n}$ together with a proof that
$$L(A_n) \;=\; \omega(n),$$
i.e., prove a superlinear lower bound on the size of any linear Boolean circuit (using only parity gates of fan-in 2) computing the multi-output linear map $x \mapsto A_n x$.
artifact.status_search_result: No superlinear lower bound is known for explicit linear maps computed by XOR-only circuits. The strongest known bound for an explicit matrix family is 3n − o(n) (Chashkin), while a counting argument gives Θ(n²/log n) for random matrices. The problem is widely cited as a major open question in circuit complexity.

status_evidence.title: Circuit Depth Reductions (Golovnev et al., ITCS 2021)
status_evidence.snippet: Superlinear lower bounds are not known even for linear circuits (XOR-only); best explicit lower bound is 3n-o(n) while random matrices need Θ(n²/log n).
status_evidence.claim: Proving a superlinear lower bound for explicit linear maps over GF(2) computed by XOR-only circuits remains open.

status_evidence.title: Circuit complexity - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: No superlinear lower bound is known for any explicit Boolean function in the unrestricted circuit model.
status_evidence.claim: Superlinear lower bounds for explicit functions, including linear maps, are unknown.
